dialogues.speaker: Trofimova
dialogues.text: Please show your credentials before entering the Armory Palace...

dialogues.speaker: Trofimova
dialogues.text: The largest and most impressive production and design institution in all of Snezhnaya, and my home...

dialogues.speaker: Trofimova
dialogues.text: If you ever have the chance to work here, make sure you hold your head high at all times.

dialogues.speaker: Trofimova
dialogues.text: Because becoming a member of the Armory Palace will be one of the proudest achievements of your life. Do you understand?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're not very intimidating for a gate guard.

dialogues.speaker: Trofimova
dialogues.text: Well said. I really can't stop you, and I don't want to be a gate guard anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Trofimova
dialogues.text: So go ahead and knock me out. That way, my superiors won't make me do this pointless job again.

dialogues.speaker: Trofimova
dialogues.text: After all, all I did was work fourteen hours a day, and they moved me here to stand guard, saying it would "help me adjust my condition and improve my health"...

dialogues.speaker: Trofimova
dialogues.text: All I need is to be with my beloved landcruisers.

dialogues.speaker: Trofimova
dialogues.text: The more landcruisers I repair, and the more detailed manuals and textbooks I read, the further my engineering skills will advance.

dialogues.speaker: Trofimova
dialogues.text: One day, I’ll catch up to my brother Kartsev...
